findings.current: Mae Jonghak remained in deep seclusion at a hidden Huashan residence and had been there at least ten years before the luncheon; Cheongpung came to Huashan at about age three or four rather than being born there.
findings.defect: The present-tense claim that Mae Jonghak remains in seclusion contradicts the subsequent active-continuity entry stating that he left Huashan and disappeared.
findings.rationale: The replacement preserves the established duration and Cheongpung hook while making Mae Jonghak's former seclusion consistent with his current disappearance.
findings.replacement: Before disappearing, Mae Jonghak had remained in deep seclusion at a hidden Huashan residence for at least ten years; Cheongpung came to Huashan at about age three or four rather than being born there.

findings.current: Having obtained the royal guard gear set he had longed for so desperately, he decided to stay at the Jin Family of Taiyuan for the time being.
findings.defect: The established System item name drifts from “Royal Guard Armor Set” to the generic and differently capitalized “royal guard gear set.”
findings.rationale: Using the binding item name maintains terminology continuity with the checkpoint decisions and System reward.
findings.replacement: Having obtained the Royal Guard Armor Set he had longed for so desperately, he decided to stay at the Jin Family of Taiyuan for the time being.
findings.source: Chapter 146, departure from Prince Shangshan's residence

findings.current: Putting aside the fact that he was a Peak master, he was the Disciple of the Sword Saint and Huashan’s direct Disciple.
findings.defect: Common-noun uses of “disciple” are unnecessarily capitalized, and the missing article before “Huashan’s direct disciple” makes the sentence sound translated rather than natural.
findings.rationale: The revision retains both affiliations while restoring natural contemporary English and consistent capitalization.
findings.replacement: Putting aside the fact that he was a Peak master, he was a disciple of the Sword Saint and a direct disciple of Huashan.
findings.source: Chapter 145, Li Feng confronts the Five Gates' heirs

findings.current: “Ehem. It feels strange to say this myself, but Taekyung really is an extraordinary talent.
findings.defect: “Ehem” is a nonstandard rendering of the English throat-clearing interjection and clashes with the otherwise contemporary prose.
findings.rationale: “Ahem” is the standard English interjection and preserves Jin Wikyung's self-conscious throat-clearing.
findings.replacement: “Ahem. It feels strange to say this myself, but Taekyung really is an extraordinary talent.

findings.defect: This line uses three periods instead of the required ellipsis character.
findings.rationale: The replacement conforms to the packet's binding punctuation rule without changing Chulwoo's hesitation.

summary: The packet is coherent and preserves its major hooks, but the active state contains one temporal contradiction and the reading copies have several minor terminology, capitalization, and punctuation inconsistencies.
